object_description: nine staggered linear volumes joined by an internal connecting wing
design_condition: The volumes align east-west with the surrounding military buildings, shorten the northern street frontage to form a precise entrance area, respect the avenue scale, and anticipate greater height toward the rear.

positive.statement: The considered urban planning approach adopts the volumetric rigor and serial arrangement of the surrounding military buildings.

position.target: serial arrangement and surrounding military buildings
position.rationale: The repeated east-west volumes visibly establish a rigorous site-scale serial arrangement.

positive.statement: Shortening the northern building creates a clearly defined access area and a precise extension of the historic axis.

position.target: northern access area and historic axis
position.rationale: The shortened northern frontage creates an identifiable access zone along the upper site edge.

positive.statement: The street frontage respects the scale of the surrounding buildings.

position.rationale: The northern edge is visibly defined by the shortened street-facing building sequence.

positive.statement: The internal connecting wing forms a clear functional backbone and makes orientation easy.

position.rationale: The internal longitudinal connection is approximated through the centre of the repeated masses.

positive.statement: The sequence of covered courtyards noticeably increases the spaciousness of the internal connection.

position.rationale: Repeated gaps between the linear volumes visibly form a sequence of courtyard-like spaces.

positive.statement: The office wings can be combined horizontally and vertically, allowing several variants for distributing organizational units.

position.rationale: The repeated rear and central wings provide the plausible anchor for flexible office groupings.

positive.statement: All office workstations are appropriately sized, easily accessible and well lit.

position.rationale: Interior workstations are unseen, so the office-wing surface provides an approximate anchor.

positive.statement: The outer facades establish a coherent connection to the surrounding roof landscapes and add a welcome degree of sensuality.

position.rationale: The perimeter edges of the repeated volumes visibly define the outer facades.

positive.statement: The thematic courtyards create varied atmospheres and enhance the quality of stay in the interior spaces.

position.rationale: The repeated internal voids are visibly distributed among the building bodies.

positive.statement: The proposal integrates security elements into the open-space concept with elegant means.

position.rationale: The northern access area provides the most plausible surface anchor for security elements.

positive.statement: Overall, the project is skilful and very precise, fitting into the existing structure of the military installations.

position.rationale: The complete serial campus arrangement anchors the overall assessment.

negative.statement: The stringency of the concept leaves few options to omit or reduce one or two courtyards.

position.rationale: The repeated courtyard gaps are visibly embedded in the rigid serial composition.

negative.statement: The proposed tree species and growth height have only a limited dialogue with the building scale and district open spaces.

position.target: proposed tree species and growth height
position.rationale: Open courtyard and perimeter surfaces provide an approximate landscape anchor; trees are not distinguishable.

negative.statement: The tight sequence of building bodies and rigid grid structure should be moderated by deliberate rule breaks.

position.target: tight sequence of building bodies and grid structure
position.rationale: The dense repeated bodies and aligned levels are clearly visible across the model.
